text:
First, I'd like to commend the doctor. She's lovely, speaks kindly, gives excellent advice, and has a very gentle touch.

*However, I would like to complain about one of the counter staff members. Their demeanor was quite unpleasant. Please improve this. I saw many negative reviews about this staff member before visiting and thought I wouldn't encounter a negative experience, but I did. Please take this feedback into consideration and make improvements. I appreciate the good service from others and don't want one person's actions to negatively impact the overall experience. Thank you. 🤍

restaurant_name: W Dental Clinic ดับเบิลยูเด็นทัลคลินิก จ.กระบี่
text:
I've been a regular customer for 4-5 years. Even after moving to work in another province, I still had to come to Krabi for treatment without any problems. I understand that walk-in customers have to wait, which is normal. However, the problem I encountered today, and the feeling that if it were possible to remove the appliance today, I would have asked the doctor to do it already, because I don't want to use their services again. The point is, beforehand, I called and was told to come before noon because it was a walk-in queue. So I woke up early, drove from Phuket, and arrived here, only to be met with a staff member who refused everything. They said, "Customers can't get treatment here," "You have to wait," "The queue is full," and so on. So what? Do I have to go back? I understand that I can't wait because I didn't have an appointment, but if they told me to come just to say the queue was full or whatever, they should have told me when I called. As employees, if you're going to work in customer service, you should find ways to persuade customers better. Please train the new staff, the tomboy and the female employee, to improve their service behavior, or replace the staff altogether.
Thank you.

text: I had a previous experience getting braces at another clinic, where they rushed me out of work and gave me a quick checkup. They answered my questions quickly, which made me feel uncomfortable. After changing clinics, I felt a bit better. I've been getting braces at Double W Clinic for four months now, and my teeth are moving much faster than I expected. The dentists are lovely and attentive, and they answer every question I ask. I tend to be inquisitive, but the dentists are patient and explain everything, which makes me feel relaxed during the treatment. The prices are reasonable, and the clinic is clean. The staff are sweet-talking and treat me like family. Even students like me can afford it, and there's an installment plan. For metal braces, there are a wide variety of rubber band colors to choose from. I had so much fun choosing between them. 🥰😁😁
